title: Bella Hadid
wiki_lead:
Isabella Khair Hadid ( hə-DEED; born October 9, 1996) is an American fashion model. In 2022, she was named Model of the Year by the British Fashion Council. Throughout her career, Hadid has appeared on the covers of numerous international editions of Vogue. Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world on its annual list in 2023.
Hadid began her modeling career aged 16. She was signed to IMG Models in August 2014, and made her New York Fashion Week debut the following month. In 2016, she was voted "Model of the Year" by industry professionals for Models.com. In 2017, Hadid broke Doutzen Kroes's record for the most Vogue September covers in one year by appearing in five international editions. As of 2023, Hadid was one of the world's highest paid models, earning $19 million.
wiki_fulltext:
Isabella Khair Hadid ( hə-DEED; born October 9, 1996) is an American fashion model. In 2022, she was named Model of the Year by the British Fashion Council. Throughout her career, Hadid has appeared on the covers of numerous international editions of Vogue. Time magazine named her one of the 100 most influential people in the world on its annual list in 2023.
Hadid began her modeling career aged 16. She was signed to IMG Models in August 2014, and made her New York Fashion Week debut the following month. In 2016, she was voted "Model of the Year" by industry professionals for Models.com. In 2017, Hadid broke Doutzen Kroes's record for the most Vogue September covers in one year by appearing in five international editions. As of 2023, Hadid was one of the world's highest paid models, earning $19 million.


Early life
Hadid was born on October 9, 1996, in Washington, D.C., and raised in Southern California. Her father, Mohamed Hadid, is a Palestinian-American real-estate developer, while her mother, Yolanda Hadid (née van den Herik), is a Dutch former model. Her father, Mohamed Hadid, has claimed that his family descends from Daher al-Umar, an 18th-century ruler of northern Palestine. She has an older sister, Gigi Hadid, and a younger brother, both of whom are also models. She also has two older paternal half-sisters.
In May 2025, Hadid and her sister Gigi announced in a statement that they have a younger half-sister, through their father, who is named Aydan Nix, whom they contacted in late 2023. Nix was welcomed by her mother, Terri Hatfield Dull, after a brief relationship with Mohamed that came after his divorce from Yolanda.  Hadid and her siblings were raised on a ranch in Santa Barbara, California. The family moved to Beverly Hills after ten years. Hadid's childhood home was destroyed in January 2025 due to the series of wildfires in Southern California.
As a teenager, Hadid was an equestrian in the discipline of equitation, and dreamed of competing at the 2016 Summer Olympics, but equitation was not among the equestrian disciplines contested at the Games.
During high school, Hadid was prescribed Adderall for difficulties with attention, which her psychiatrist suspected might be related to attention deficit hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). In a 2022 interview with Vogue, Hadid said that the medication's appetite-suppressing effects had contributed to her developing anorexia nervosa. She was diagnosed, along with her mother and brother, with chronic Lyme disease in 2012.
After graduating from Malibu High School in 2014, Hadid moved to New York City to study photography at the Parsons School of Design until she suspended her studies to focus on her modelling career. She has expressed an interest in returning to education to branch out into fashion photography.


Career


2012–2015: Early career
Hadid began modeling at age 16, with a commercial project for Flynn Skye in 2012. Before signing with a major modeling agency, she appeared in photographer Lesa Amoore's project The Swan Sittings and modeled for Hanna Hayes' Fall/Winter 2013 collection. She also modeled for Chrome Hearts, a fashion and accessories brand founded by the mother of her childhood friend Jesse Jo Stark.
Hadid signed to IMG Models on August 21, 2014. She made her New York Fashion Week debut in September, walking for Desigual. In December, Hadid made her first cover appearance on Jalouse, and was featured on day 27 of Love magazine's Love Advent Calendar.
In February 2015, Hadid appeared in the spring advertising campaign for handbag brand Botkier. Later that month, she walked in Tom Ford's Fall/Winter 2015 runway show, marking one of her first major appearances on the catwalk. In March, she appeared in "Fantasy Campaigns", an editorial project published by Carine Roitfeld's CR Fashion Book. In April, she was featured in another editorial for the publication, "Body by Bella". In May, she participated in amfAR's 22nd Cinema Against AIDS Gala.
In July 2015, Hadid appeared alongside Gigi in Balmain's Fall 2015 advertising campaign. In August, she appeared alongside Xiao Wen Ju in a Samsung lookbook promoting the Samsung Galaxy S6 Edge+ and Samsung Galaxy Note 5, photographed by Steven Klein. That month, she was announced as a model for Victoria's Secret Pink's holiday campaign alongside Rachel Hilbert and Devon Windsor.
During the fall 2015 fashion weeks, Hadid walked in New York, London, Milan and Paris for designers and fashion houses including Diane von Fürstenberg, Marc Jacobs, Tommy Hilfiger, Jeremy Scott, Topshop Unique, Moschino, Bottega Veneta and Balmain. She appeared in the November 2015 issue of Seventeen and in Topshop's holiday advertising campaign. In December, she made her Chanel runway debut at the fashion house's Métiers d'Art show in Rome. She also appeared in two installments of Love magazine's annual Advent Calendar.
Hadid's magazine work in 2015 included an eight-page fashion editorial in the February issue of Teen Vogue. She appeared on the covers of Grey and Unconditional magazines that spring and summer. In June, she appeared alongside Gigi on the cover of V magazine's Fall Preview issue, their first joint magazine cover. Later that year, she appeared on the cover of Editorialist's Fall/Winter issue and on one of the covers of Wonderland's tenth-anniversary issue.


2016–2017: Breakthrough
In January 2016, Hadid made her Chanel haute couture debut at the fashion house's Spring/Summer 2016 show in Paris. She also appeared in Marc Jacobs's Spring 2016 advertising campaign. In February, she walked in Rihanna's Fenty x Puma debut show at New York Fashion Week. In March, she walked exclusively for Givenchy at Paris Fashion Week and appeared in the Spring 2016 advertising campaign for Joe's Jeans.
In May, Hadid made her Australian runway debut at Mercedes-Benz Fashion Week Australia, opening and closing Misha Collection's Resort 2017 show. She also participated in the fashion show held during amfAR's 23rd Cinema Against AIDS Gala at the Cannes Film Festival. Later that month, she walked in Dior's Cruise 2017 show at Blenheim Palace in Oxfordshire, England.
On May 31, 2016, Hadid was announced as a makeup ambassador for Dior. She subsequently appeared alongside makeup artist Peter Philips in the brand's online video series Dior Makeup Live with Bella Hadid, which premiered on June 6.
In June, Hadid modeled a look from Givenchy's Fall 2016 haute couture collection during the fashion house's Spring 2017 menswear show in Paris. In July, she walked in the Fall/Winter 2016–2017 haute couture shows for Atelier Versace and Dior, and closed Alexandre Vauthier's couture presentation in Paris. On July 7, she participated in Fendi's 90th-anniversary Haute Fourrure show, staged on a transparent runway over the Trevi Fountain in Rome.
Hadid's advertising work in 2016 included campaigns for Topshop's Spring/Summer denim collection, Givenchy's Fall/Winter collection, Calvin Klein's global Fall 2016 campaign, and J.W. Anderson's Fall/Winter campaign. In August, she photographed her longtime friends Jesse Jo Stark and Laurie Lynn Stark for W magazine at the headquarters of Chrome Hearts.
During the September 2016 fashion weeks, Hadid opened DKNY's Spring/Summer 2017 show in New York and walked for designers including Michael Kors, Anna Sui, Ralph Lauren and Marc Jacobs. She exclusively opened Versus Versace's show at London Fashion Week. At Milan Fashion Week, she opened the Spring/Summer 2017 presentations for Alberta Ferretti and Fendi, and closed the show for Philosophy di Lorenzo Serafini.
In October, Hadid appeared in the advertising campaign for Australian label Misha Collection's Gold by Misha range. On November 30, she made her Victoria's Secret Fashion Show debut in Paris. On December 13, she announced her first fashion design collaboration, a collection created with Chrome Hearts.
Hadid appeared on the cover of the March 2016 issue of Allure. In May, she made her first Vogue cover appearance in the Turkish edition of the magazine, photographed by Sebastian Faena. She also appeared on the June cover of the American edition of Elle, photographed by Terry Tsiolis.
In August 2016, Hadid appeared alongside South Korean rapper G-Dragon on the cover of Vogue Me, photographed by Mario Testino. She subsequently appeared on the September covers of Vogue Japan, Vogue Italia, photographed by Steven Meisel, and Vogue Paris, the latter alongside model Taylor Hill.
That year, Hadid appeared in Private, a short film directed by Tyler Ford for Visionaire magazine's 25th-anniversary project. In December, she was featured in the opening installment of Love magazine's 2016 Advent Calendar, directed by photographer Rankin.
In January 2017, Hadid walked in Givenchy's Fall 2017 menswear and Spring 2017 haute couture presentation in Paris. She also walked in Chanel's Spring 2017 haute couture show and opened Alexandre Vauthier's couture presentation.
On February 8, Hadid walked in Tommy Hilfiger's Spring 2017 show at Venice Beach in Los Angeles, presenting the Tommy x Gigi collection designed in collaboration with Gigi. That month, she was announced as an ambassador for Bulgari's accessories collections and for Swiss watchmaker TAG Heuer.
During New York Fashion Week, Hadid opened the Fall 2017 shows for Prabal Gurung and Zadig & Voltaire, and closed for Oscar de la Renta. She also walked for designers including Alexander Wang, Sies Marjan, Carolina Herrera, Brandon Maxwell, Michael Kors, Anna Sui and Ralph Lauren. At London Fashion Week, she closed Versus Versace's Fall 2017 show, which was opened by Gigi.
On March 1, Hadid closed H&M Studio's Spring 2017 show in Paris, which was opened by Gigi.

In February 2017, Hadid walked for Alberta Ferretti, Fendi, Moschino and Versace at Milan Fashion Week. At Paris Fashion Week in March, she walked for Lanvin and Chanel, and opened Off-White's Fall 2017 show.
In May, Hadid participated in Naomi Campbell's Fashion for Relief charity runway show during the 2017 Cannes Film Festival. She also attended amfAR's 24th Cinema Against AIDS Gala in Cap d'Antibes, France.
In July, Hadid walked in Miu Miu's Cruise 2018 presentation and the Fall 2017 haute couture shows for Alexandre Vauthier, Maison Margiela and Fendi. She opened Vauthier's couture show in Paris.
In early 2017, Hadid appeared alongside Gigi in the Spring/Summer advertising campaigns for Fendi and Moschino. She also featured in campaigns for DKNY and TAG Heuer, and appeared alongside Anwar in Zadig & Voltaire's Spring/Summer campaign. In March, her first advertising campaign for Dior Beauty was released, promoting Diorshow Pump'N'Volume mascara.
In May, Hadid appeared in a Nike campaign celebrating the 45th anniversary of the Nike Cortez sneaker. She was also announced as the face of Bulgari's Goldea, The Roman Night fragrance and featured in Giuseppe Zanotti's Fall 2017 footwear campaign, photographed by Mario Sorrenti.
In June, Hadid was announced as the face of Max Mara's accessories line for Fall/Winter 2017, in a campaign photographed by Steven Meisel. She appeared alongside Zayn Malik in the advertising campaign for Zayn x Versus, a clothing collaboration with Versus Versace. She also appeared in NARS Cosmetics' campaign for Powermatte Lip Pigment, photographed by François Nars.
In July, Hadid appeared alongside Kendall Jenner in Chinese fashion brand Ochirly's Fall/Winter 2017 campaign, photographed by Mario Sorrenti. In August, she became the face of Philippine clothing brand Penshoppe's Generation Now campaign.
In January 2017, Hadid appeared on the cover of W Korea, which reused an editorial photographed by Venetia Scott for the October 2016 American edition of W. In February, she appeared alongside musician Jesse Jo Stark in Teen Vogue's first volume of 2017, photographed by Daniel Jackson. grok_lead: Isabella Khair Hadid (born October 9, 1996), known professionally as Bella Hadid, is an American fashion model who rose to international prominence in the mid-2010s. Born in Washington, D.C., to Palestinian-American real estate developer Mohamed Hadid and Dutch former model Yolanda Hadid, she grew up in a family with ties to the modeling industry, including her sister Gigi Hadid. Hadid began her modeling career in 2014, signing with IMG Models and walking runways for major designers such as Chanel, Dior, and Marc Jacobs, while appearing on numerous magazine covers and in advertising campaigns. Her achievements include being named Model of the Year at the British Fashion Awards in 2022 and recognition for her influence in high fashion. Hadid has publicly advocated for Palestinian rights, drawing criticism for statements perceived as anti-Israel and leading to professional fallout, such as Adidas removing her from its 2024 campaign for the SL72, a reissue of a sneaker originally designed for the 1972 Munich Olympics, where 11 members of the Israeli team were killed in a Palestinian terror attack, after objections from Israel's official X account and the American Jewish Committee; Adidas later apologized to her and its other partners.
